strategyDefinition.seed: long layers at and below the completed-close anchor
strategyDefinition.longCompletion: close profitable long and open same-quantity short at the long TP
strategyDefinition.shortCompletion: close profitable short and open same-quantity long at the short TP
strategyDefinition.overlap: different chains may hold staggered long and short inventory simultaneously
strategyDefinition.sameBarRule: a newly reversed leg cannot complete again on the same candle
strategyDefinition.liquidation: maintenance-margin test is applied to adverse candle extremes before favorable flips

decision.rule: Positive median in validation, test, stressed test and full interval, with zero liquidations.
